action: Update Zyxel DX3300-T0, DX3301-T0 and EX3301-T0 devices to firmware newer than 5.50(ABVY.8.3)C0, following Zyxel's advisory.
exec: Routine firmware patch notice for Zyxel customer-premises devices; no exploitation reported.
plain: Canada's cyber agency told users of certain Zyxel home and small-office internet routers to install updated firmware.
summary: Cyber Centre advisory AV26-1167 covers vulnerabilities in Zyxel DX3300-T0, DX3301-T0 and EX3301-T0 firmware at or below 5.50(ABVY.8.3)C0. It points to Zyxel's November 17 advisory on an out-of-bounds write and a post-authentication command injection in certain DSL/Ethernet CPE, fiber ONTs and wireless extenders. No exploitation is reported in the feed entry.
title: Canadian Centre for Cyber Security issues Zyxel advisory AV26-1167 for DSL/Ethernet CPE firmware

validation.note: Taken from the Canadian Centre for Cyber Security's own advisory feed entry.

review.note: Compared title, AV26-1167, 17 Nov date, three products and firmware <=5.50(ABVY.8.3)C0, no exploitation against the Cyber Centre page
